scope: All inferno and inferno-skinned confluence levels at production 1440x900 camera. Rays from all legal-cell centers plus actual imported camera-facing goal ring/tooth and portal spiral triangle vertices, edge midpoints and centroids toward orthographic camera against exact transformed wall triangles. Candidate hits self-occluded by the glyph asset are excluded using its exact triangles. Finite surface sampling is not a whole-pixel proof; matched native frames independently reviewed.
